name: Gong
tagline: Gong is an AI revenue intelligence platform that records and analyses every customer call, email, and demo to surface patterns that separate winning deals from lost ones. Its machine-learning models highlight moments where reps go off-script, flag at-risk deals based on conversation signals, and coach individuals with clip-based feedback. Sales leaders at growth-stage and enterprise companies use Gong to systematise what their best reps do.
